rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); SkiaSurface gains trim_gpu_resources() with an unused_for(idle) level and an everything level, gpu_cache_bytes() reporting budgeted and purgeable bytes, and idle_trim_count(). end_frame() runs unused_for(2 s) behind GpuIdleTrimSchedule, at most once per second, so a steady frame pays one timestamp compare. The Graphite surface purges the recorder's and the context's resource caches after retiring finished recordings; the WebGL2 surface purges its GrDirectContext. Only resources nothing references are freed, so cached images, retained layers and the scene are untouched and pixels do not change; a trim is refused while a frame is open. No frame, present, readback, design-import, Chromium, packaging or authority boundary moves; the Pulp render target has not adopted a Vellum package.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'GpuIdleTrimSchedule is due once per interval'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface idle trim frees textures unused for two seconds and keeps the drawn one'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface idle trim runs once per second of frames'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface trim everything returns released image textures to the device'
